findings.note: Allen, now with the Hornets and facing his old Suns team, had 27 points, 4 rebounds and 6 assists (37 PRA) in 34 minutes in the Nov 10 win over Cleveland. His season averages are 15.3 points, 2.8 rebounds and 3.0 assists in 26.6 minutes, and the line is 24.5.

Through 10 games he averaged 14.1 points, 2.7 rebounds and 2.7 assists in 25.9 minutes, roughly 19.5 PRA. His game log swings widely, including a 0-point start against Boston (5 PRA) and games of 5 and 11 points.

Allen made his first start on Nov 6 because Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Dennis Schroder (thigh) were out. He averaged 17.6 points, 3.0 rebounds and 4.1 assists as a starter in 2025-26, and searches found no injury status for this game or analyst picks on this market.
